reason: A DSH web GUI plugin that responsively expands the chat content column and related rows by injecting CSS, with configurable width limits.

summaries.zh: 通过注入 CSS 让 DSH Web GUI 的聊天内容区域及相关行根据窗口宽度自适应扩展。
summaries.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that uses injected CSS to make the chat content area and related rows adapt to the window width.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS to override chat content width
Adjusts chat message and statistics row layout responsively
Reads and writes a browser localStorage setting for optional width configuration
